column1: # Reviewed flag specification of the restricted-tier POSIX programs, per platform
# (rel-1-0-10 GAP-0219). The restricted tier may block on a known mutation by cp,
# mv, ln, tee, rm or install (effectrules.RestrictedBlockPrograms), so each of these
# rows, and its siblings unlink and shred, must accept exactly the flags the real
# program accepts on that platform: a flag the program rejects makes the command
# fail without touching the file, so it must stay unaccounted.
# gnu = GNU coreutils (Linux, Git Bash); bsd = the BSD tools of macOS (man pages of
# macOS 26: cp, mv, ln, rm, install, tee). The BSD tools take no long options; BSD
# cp, mv and ln have no -t. A program listed for a platform with no lines here
# (unlink on both) accepts no option. Deliberately absent (unaccounted): install -d,
# rm/shred/install flags of the sibling program.
# TestRestrictedFlagSpecMatchesTables reads THIS file: a flag added to a table row
# without a reviewed line here fails the build, and so does a line with no flag.
# arity: 0 = switch, 1 = takes a value, opt = a switch with an optional value
# attached to its own token only (--backup[=CONTROL]). TestFlagSpecRunOracle and
# TestFlagSpecHelpOracle check the gnu rows against coreutils (GAP-0216).
